findings.title: Update artifact host allowlist exists but is not configured in the shipped image
evidence: src/falcon_agent/runner.py:49-69 validate_update_url no-ops unless allowed_hosts is set
findings.impact: The agent will download a signed manifest's artifact from any HTTPS host when no allowlist is configured; a compromised control plane / signing seed can steer the fleet at an arbitrary host (exfiltration or hostile payload).
findings.recommendation: Set update_allowed_hosts in the shipped agent.json (control-plane host / object store) so the URL is scheme- and host-restricted by default.
findings.note: mechanism added (CHAIN/API/SEC fix); default config leaves it disabled

findings.title: Root-side update verifier rejects symlink/traversal/setuid archive members
evidence: digest verified against the signed manifest (runner.py:553-554)
findings.impact: Archive handling is hardened; residual is the unconfigured host allowlist above.
